The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Vaug]] was '''liberated''' by the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==The battle==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="GrS" /> following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Vaug]] was taken from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control<ref name="SW98" /> by an [[Alliance of Free Planets]] force that included [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Onassi]].<ref name="E&A" />

==Aftermath==
Discovering within an internment facility the young [[Venerated Ones]] of [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]], [[Lillindri Nanimei Filda Vandelhelm XXXII]] and [[Endrodanar Tiopuld Shaamador Vandelhelm XXIV]], prisoners on the planet for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Alliance required an escort to [[Mission to Vandelhelm|return]] the nobles to their homeworld. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was selected by [[Gender/Legends|his]] old friend General [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] for his skill as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="E&A" />
